# Infuse VR
VR Streaming, Motion Compensation, Hand & Accessories Visualization, Cockpit Calibration

Infuse VR is a headset streaming application (based on ALVR) and a hand and gaming accessories visualization software for VR gamers. It allows you to see your hands and gaming accessories during gameplay, regardless of the game you're playing. This means you can interact with both the virtual and physical worlds simultaneously.

You can build custom controllers or even entire cockpits and display them in-game. Aligning the virtual cockpit with your physical setup is quick and easy.

Using a motion simulator? The built-in motion compensation module can be activated with just one click.

Don’t see your controller on the devices list? No problem! You can create your own 3D model and upload it to Infuse.

Main Features:

- Hand visualization (with finger tracking)
- Gaming accessories visualization
- Support for multiple visualization modes:
- X-ray
- Transparent
- Colored
- Original shading
- Multi-profile support (load and save profiles)
- Motion compensation
- Wi-Fi / USB streaming (via ALVR)
